faqs.title: Questions wey people dey always ask
faqs.subtitle: Everything wey you need to know to start with FocusPond.

what-is.question: Wetin be FocusPond?
what-is.answer: FocusPond na your quiet corner of the internet to plan, focus, and feel less overwhelmed. Na calm productivity space with tools like Pomodoro timer, daily tasks, Frog of the Day, and gentle mood check-ins, all to helep you work with ease, no be pressure.

is-free.question: FocusPond free?
is-free.answer: Yes, FocusPond free completely as we still dey our early stage. You go always get access to the essentials, even when premium features come later.

offline.question: E dey work offline?
offline.answer: Yes, you fit use FocusPond even without internet. Your data dey safe for your device and e go sync online when you create account.

frog-of-day.question: Wetin be the 'Frog of the Day'?
frog-of-day.answer: Your Frog of the Day na the most important task wey you choose to tackle first. E no be about urgency, na about doing the one thing wey go make your day feel productive and calm.

identify-frog.question: How I go take identify 'Frog task'?
identify-frog.answer: Frog task na the one wey you don dey postpone, usually because e feel big or important. E suppose take around 1 to 4 hours. If e feel too much, break am into small steps and start with the first one.

no-account.question: I fit use FocusPond without creating account?
no-account.answer: Yes. You fit start to use FocusPond straight away without signing up; everything wey you do dey save for your device. Creating account later just dey helep you back up your progress and sync am across devices.

vibe-switcher.question: Wetin be the vibe switcher?
vibe-switcher.answer: E dey let you choose how the app dey talk to you and for which language, calm and formal for English, relaxed for Naijá (Pidgin), or for Igbo, Yorùbá, Hausa, or French. Pick the vibe wey match your mood for the day.

cta.title: Start your day with clarity
cta.subtitle: No account needed. E dey work offline. Zero pressure.
